title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Solid Brass, 8 Pivoting Pegs | Brushed Bronze | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Need a no-drill place to hang coats and towels in the bathroom? This freestanding coat rack (also used as a towel stand or garment rack) keeps items off chairs and counters with eight pivoting pegs for organized, easy access in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. Built with solid brass construction and designed as transitional bathroom hardware, it complements versatile bath accessories while letting you place it anywhere—no wall mount, wall-mounted brackets, or wall hanging installation required.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stable on the floor: weighted base is designed to keep the rack stable to prevent tipping
- Floor-friendly: felt pad helps prevent scratching on tile, wood, or other surfaces
- Coordinate a matching look: part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: freestanding coat rack / towel stand / garment rack
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in.
- Material: solid brass; brass construction
- Base: weighted base with felt pad
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 26 x 26 x 12 in.
- Shipping weight: 18 lbs.
